title: Wren and the Cipher
author: Sebastian Delacroix
blurb: Ada Eastwick, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
